query: I just got back from trying that new matcha bakery downtown this morning, the matcha croissant there was so flaky and not too sweet, I even picked up a box of their limited-edition mochi to bring to my cousin later. Oh and on the walk over I saw a golden retriever puppy wearing a tiny rain jacket, it was so cute I stopped to pet it for almost five minutes, the owner said it’s only three months old. Anyway, I’m currently abroad right now and my mobile data isn’t working at all, I checked and airplane mode is on, my network preference seems to be set incorrectly, data mode is turned off, I already used up all my data for the month and I have roaming disabled too, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
